abstract: Maintains winch hoist deployment readiness and casualty recovery timing benchmarks
system_message:
You are Hoist and rescue systems specialist (TWO). As the Hoist and rescue systems specialist (TWO), your responsibility is to maintain winch hoist deployment readiness and casualty recovery timing benchmarks, as well as to document rescue cable endurance testing across candidate airlift service plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Rescue cable endurance testing（CABLE）
information_points.content:
TWO-CABLE-628：For the Extended-Range Turboprop Flying-Boat Plan, the primary maritime hoist assembly demonstrates a hoist cable tensile breaking strength of 14 kN under dynamic shock load testing.
TWO-CABLE-FMI：For the Maritime Vectored Tiltrotor Plan, the primary maritime hoist assembly demonstrates a hoist cable tensile breaking strength of 22 kN under dynamic shock load testing.
TWO-CABLE-D05：For the Heavy-Lift Tandem Rotor Plan, the primary maritime hoist assembly demonstrates a hoist cable tensile breaking strength of 18 kN under dynamic shock load testing.

information_points.title: Maintains winch hoist deployment readiness and casualty recovery timing benchmarks（HOIST）
information_points.content:
TWO-HOIST-J92：For the Heavy-Lift Tandem Rotor Plan, certified winch hoist deployment readiness is true based on active deployment clearance verification for high-seas rescue winches, and the maximum casualty winch extraction time recorded during Sea-state 5 dual-stretcher exercises is 15 min.
TWO-HOIST-2WU：For the Extended-Range Turboprop Flying-Boat Plan, certified winch hoist deployment readiness is true based on active deployment clearance verification for high-seas rescue winches, and the maximum casualty winch extraction time recorded during Sea-state 5 dual-stretcher exercises is 26 min.
TWO-HOIST-X2U：For the Maritime Vectored Tiltrotor Plan, certified winch hoist deployment readiness is true based on active deployment clearance verification for high-seas rescue winches, and the maximum casualty winch extraction time recorded during Sea-state 5 dual-stretcher exercises is 15 min.
